global: A steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender pork slices and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with black Greek-key trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
